$comment: GENERATED by scripts/registry.mjs (npm run charts:registry). Search this before building a chart (RULES.md #1).

charts.name: Adjacency matrix
charts.summary: Links between the members of one set as an n × n grid of cells.

charts.name: Alluvial diagram
charts.summary: How one population divides across categorical stages, in a fixed column order.

charts.name: Arc diagram
charts.summary: Nodes along a line with every connection drawn as an arc above it.

charts.name: Area chart
charts.summary: One value over time, filled down to zero to show volume.

charts.name: Bar chart
charts.summary: Vertical bars comparing one value across categories.

charts.name: Beeswarm chart
charts.summary: Every value as its own circle along an axis, dodged so none overlap.

charts.name: Box plot
charts.summary: Median, quartiles, whiskers and outliers of a value across groups.

charts.name: Bubble chart
charts.summary: A scatter plot whose dots are sized by a third measure: bubble area is proportional to size.

charts.name: Bubble map
charts.summary: Circles sized by a value on a world or US map.

charts.name: Bullet chart
charts.summary: Few's bullet graph: a measure bar, a target tick and qualitative bands, one per row.

charts.name: Bump chart
charts.summary: Rank of each series at each time point, joined by smooth lines; 1 at the top.

charts.name: Burndown chart
charts.summary: Work remaining over time against the ideal line to zero, with scope changes flagged.

charts.name: Burnup chart
charts.summary: Completed work climbing toward total scope, with the projected completion date.

charts.name: Calendar heatmap
charts.summary: Days laid out as weeks × weekdays per year, shaded by value (GitHub style).

charts.name: Candlestick chart
charts.summary: Open, high, low and close per session as candles, with optional volume.

charts.name: Chord diagram
charts.summary: Flows between groups around a circle: arc length is what a group sends, ribbons join each pair.

charts.name: Choropleth map
charts.summary: Countries or US states shaded by a value.

charts.name: Circle packing
charts.summary: Nested circles: each group encloses its members, each leaf sized by its value.

charts.name: Connected scatter plot
charts.summary: Points at (x, y) joined in order, so the path shows how two measures moved together over time.

charts.name: Contour density plot
charts.summary: A smoothed density of points on the x/y plane, drawn as filled contour bands.

charts.name: Control chart
charts.summary: Measurements over time around their mean, with control limits and out-of-control points flagged.

charts.name: Correlation matrix
charts.summary: Pairwise correlation coefficients between numeric variables on a diverging −1…+1 scale.

charts.name: Cumulative flow diagram
charts.summary: Items in each workflow state over time, stacked in workflow order.

charts.name: Cycle plot
charts.summary: One mini line per season position (month, weekday, quarter) across cycles, with its mean.

charts.name: Dendrogram
charts.summary: A cluster tree with every leaf aligned; inner nodes placed by merge distance or by depth.

charts.name: Density plot
charts.summary: Smoothed distribution (kernel density estimate) of one or more series.

charts.name: Diverging bar chart
charts.summary: Bars extending left or right of a centre line, coloured by side: deviation from zero, a target or a scale midpoint.

charts.name: Donut chart
charts.summary: A ring of slices around the total: parts of one whole.

charts.name: Dot map
charts.summary: One dot per location on a world or US map, coloured by category.

charts.name: Dot plot
charts.summary: Cleveland dot plot: a dot per value on one line per category, several series in colour.

charts.name: Dumbbell chart
charts.summary: Two values per category joined by a line, coloured by the direction of the change.

charts.name: Empirical CDF
charts.summary: Step curve of the share of values at or below each value, one per series.

charts.name: Euler diagram
charts.summary: Up to eight sets as circles sized by count, overlapping where they share members.

charts.name: Event timeline
charts.summary: Point and range events on one time axis, packed into lanes so nothing overlaps.

charts.name: Flow map
charts.summary: Arcs between places on a map, width proportional to the volume moved.

charts.name: Network graph
charts.summary: Nodes and links laid out by a force simulation: clusters, hubs and bridges show as shape.

charts.name: Funnel chart
charts.summary: Ordered stages narrowing as items drop out, with conversion rates.

charts.name: Gantt chart
charts.summary: Tasks as bars on a time axis, with progress, milestones and dependencies.

charts.name: Gauge
charts.summary: A semicircular dial showing one value against its range, with status bands and a target.

charts.name: Grouped bar chart
charts.summary: Bars side by side per category, one per series, for comparing series within and across categories.

charts.name: Heatmap
charts.summary: A grid of cells coloured by value across two categorical or date dimensions.

charts.name: Hex-tile map
charts.summary: US states as equal hexagons on a grid, coloured by a value.

charts.name: Hexbin plot
charts.summary: Points counted into hexagonal bins, each coloured by how many points fall in it.

charts.name: Histogram
charts.summary: Counts of values falling into contiguous ranges (bins).

charts.name: Horizon chart
charts.summary: Compact rows of folded, layered area bands: many time series in little height.

charts.name: Horizontal bar chart
charts.summary: Horizontal bars comparing one value across categories; long names read horizontally.

charts.name: Icicle chart
charts.summary: Adjacent bands, one per level of a hierarchy: each node spans its share of its parent.

charts.name: KPI tile
charts.summary: A big number with its change against a previous value and an optional sparkline; a list becomes a grid of tiles.

charts.name: Line chart
charts.summary: One value over time, as a line through its points.

charts.name: Progress bar
charts.summary: Horizontal progress bars with labels and percentages; a missing value is a dashed empty track.

charts.name: Lollipop chart
charts.summary: A stem and a dot per category: a lighter-ink bar chart for comparing and ranking one value.

charts.name: Marimekko chart
charts.summary: Columns as wide as their share of the total, split by each series’ share of the column.

charts.name: Meter
charts.summary: An HTML <meter>: a bar cut into low, middle and high zones, graded optimum, suboptimum or poor against an optimum.

charts.name: Milestone timeline
charts.summary: Milestones as diamonds on one line, labels alternating above and below; done vs upcoming.

charts.name: Multi-line chart
charts.summary: Several series over time, one line each, named at their ends.

charts.name: Nested proportions
charts.summary: A part drawn inside its whole: squares sharing a corner, area proportional to value.

charts.name: OHLC chart
charts.summary: Open, high, low and close per session as tick bars, with optional volume.

charts.name: Org chart
charts.summary: Boxes for people under their managers, top-down, with elbow connectors.

charts.name: Parallel coordinates
charts.summary: One vertical axis per numeric column and one line per row crossing them all.

charts.name: Pareto chart
charts.summary: Causes as bars sorted largest first, with the cumulative share as a line against an 80% reference.

charts.name: Pie chart
charts.summary: Slices showing how a handful of parts make up one whole.

charts.name: Population pyramid
charts.summary: Back-to-back bars of two groups (usually male and female) across age bands.

charts.name: Progress ring
charts.summary: Rings that fill clockwise toward a goal, with the percentage in the middle.

charts.name: Punch card
charts.summary: Activity by weekday and hour of day as circles sized by value.

charts.name: Pyramid chart
charts.summary: A triangle sliced into levels whose areas are proportional to their values.

charts.name: Q-Q plot
charts.summary: Sorted values against normal quantiles, with a reference line: straight means normal.

charts.name: Quadrant chart
charts.summary: A scatter split into four named quadrants at a threshold on each axis.

charts.name: Radar chart
charts.summary: One polygon per series over spokes for each axis, on a concentric grid.

charts.name: Radial bar chart
charts.summary: Concentric arcs, one ring per category, each swept in proportion to its value.

charts.name: Radial tree
charts.summary: A tidy tree wrapped around its root: each depth is a ring, leaves face outward.

charts.name: Range area chart
charts.summary: A band between low and high over time (min–max or confidence interval), with an optional centre line.

charts.name: Regression scatter plot
charts.summary: A scatter plot with a least-squares fit, its confidence band, and the equation and R².

charts.name: Ridgeline plot
charts.summary: Overlapping density curves, one row per group, on a shared axis.

charts.name: Roadmap
charts.summary: Items as rounded bars in lanes on a quarter axis, coloured by status.

charts.name: Sankey diagram
charts.summary: Flows between stages as bands whose width is the quantity moved.

charts.name: Scatter plot
charts.summary: Dots at (x, y) showing how two measures move together, optionally grouped by series.

charts.name: Semi-donut chart
charts.summary: A half ring of parts with the total underneath: compact composition.

charts.name: Slope chart
charts.summary: Lines between two time points, one per item, labelled at both ends.

charts.name: Small multiples
charts.summary: One small chart per group, on a shared scale, in a grid that fits the width.

charts.name: Sparkline
charts.summary: A word-sized line showing the shape of a series, no axes.

charts.name: Scatter-plot matrix
charts.summary: Small scatter plots of every pair of numeric columns, with histograms on the diagonal.

charts.name: Stacked area chart
charts.summary: Series stacked on each other over time, so the top edge is the total.

charts.name: 100% stacked area chart
charts.summary: Each series' share of the total over time; every x adds up to 100%.

charts.name: Stacked bar chart
charts.summary: Bars built from stacked series segments: totals per category and what makes them up; negatives stack below zero.

charts.name: 100% stacked bar chart
charts.summary: Each category as a full-height bar split into its series shares, so mixes compare across categories.

charts.name: Step line chart
charts.summary: Values that hold until they change, drawn as horizontal steps.

charts.name: Streamgraph
charts.summary: Series flowing around a centre line over time; shape shows rise and fall, not exact values.

charts.name: Strip plot
charts.summary: Every value as a jittered point in its group, with the group median marked.

charts.name: Sunburst
charts.summary: Concentric rings of a hierarchy: each arc spans its share of its parent.

charts.name: Swimlane timeline
charts.summary: Items as bars in one lane per team, system or person, on a shared time axis.

charts.name: Table heatmap
charts.summary: A data table whose numeric columns are shaded by value.

charts.name: Tree
charts.summary: A tidy node-link tree: every node placed by depth, children fanned out under their parent.

charts.name: Treemap
charts.summary: Nested rectangles whose areas are proportional to the values of a hierarchy.

charts.name: UpSet plot
charts.summary: Exact sizes of every set intersection as bars over a dot matrix, set totals beside.

charts.name: Venn diagram
charts.summary: Two or three overlapping circles with areas proportional to set and overlap sizes.

charts.name: Violin plot
charts.summary: Mirrored density curves per group, with the quartiles inside.

charts.name: Waffle chart
charts.summary: A grid of squares coloured by part: shares you can count.

charts.name: Waterfall chart
charts.summary: Floating bars that walk a running total from a start to an end through increases and decreases.

charts.name: Word cloud
charts.summary: Words sized by frequency or weight, packed around the centre.
